I develop intelligent decision support tools that translate complex spatial data into actionable insights, bridging data science, AI, and geospatial systems to solve real-world challenges.

highlights.title: ML/DL-based Transportation Optimization
highlights.description: Collaborated with City of Calgary to transform urban mobility through deep learning-based traffic prediction and machine learning models for route optimization, delivering 14% improvement in travel time efficiency and 4% reduction in CO₂ emissions.

highlights.title: AI-based Fleet Optimization
highlights.description: Built vehicle routing and scheduling system using Python and mixed-integer programming that reduced fleet size by 24% and distance traveled by 19% through demand pattern optimization.

highlights.title: Shuttle Routing Solution
highlights.description: Designed cost-efficient routing system for Suncor Energy using Python optimization libraries and created interactive Flask/Mapbox dashboard for real-time visualization.

highlights.title: Financial Services Innovation
highlights.description: Developed LSTM-CNN hybrid model in TensorFlow to forecast daily cash demand for nationwide ATM network, reducing cash replenishment costs by 12%.

highlights.title: Logistics Transformation
highlights.description: Built GPS-based fleet management system with real-time tracking dashboards and Python-based routing optimization engine for cash-in-transit operations.

highlights.title: Network Optimization
highlights.description: Created GIS-based optimization tool using ArcGIS Pro and spatial analysis to evaluate ATM placement locations, improving average transaction efficiency by 15%.

highlights.title: Cross-Functional Leadership
highlights.description: Led team of 4 data scientists, coordinating model development workflows, code reviews, and stakeholder presentations while establishing data quality standards.

highlights.title: Planning Support
highlights.description: Produced thematic maps using ArcGIS Pro and QGIS for tourism projects, conducting spatial analyses including site suitability, accessibility, and demographic visualization.

highlights.title: Data Governance & Standards
highlights.description: Developed geospatial data management workflows and quality control procedures for PostgreSQL/PostGIS databases.

highlights.title: Capacity Building
